title: Local tribal people told not to look toward the property

tellings.quote: their people have been told not even to look the direction of this property for generations.

plain: Ute people on the Ouray reservation in Utah have been told for generations not even to look in the direction of Skinwalker Ranch, a nearby property long tied to reports of strange lights and happenings. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels this as something tribal people told him around 2016, a sign, if so, that local people feared the land long before it became famous.
